[d/g2074788f713e-1] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Route all time readings through a process-wide session clock.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-1-1

[d/g2074788f713e-11] decision (cited, source crates/ucal/src/clock.rs@2074788f713e)
  Ignore poison on the session mutex and take the inner value.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-11-1

[d/g2074788f713e-2] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Use max(wall_now, anchor + monotonic_elapsed) as the reading rule.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-2-2

[d/g2074788f713e-4] decision (cited, source crates/ucal/src/clock.rs@2074788f713e)
  Make Session::reading a pure function of its inputs.
  Pure function lets tests drive wall clock backwards repeatedly and assert monotonic sequence.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-4-1

[d/g2074788f713e-5] decision (cited, source crates/ucal/src/clock.rs@2074788f713e)
  Track the last reading to enforce monotonicity against smaller elapsed inputs.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-5-1

[d/g2074788f713e-6] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Store session state as Option and anchor lazily inside session_now, avoiding .expect.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-6-1

[d/g2074788f713e-7] decision (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Split wall_instant out of now_instant to expose a raw system clock reading.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-7-1

[d/g2074788f713e-9] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@2074788f713e)
  Document the session clock and its rule in CLI.md and release notes.
  Record one process, one clock and the max rule for users.
  -> causes q/g2074788f713e-9-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-1] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Add a clock section to doctor and now output.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-1-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-2] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Add doctor --clock flag to sample and report machine resolution.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-2-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-3] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Keep precision field name and value unchanged.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-3-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-4] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Do not measure accuracy.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-5] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Keep granularity, resolution, and accuracy as separate numbers.
  Conflating them is the defect; separation makes clear what each number represents.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-5-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-6] decision (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Report which error terms cancel in a difference.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-6-1

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-7] decision (cited, source Documentation/Release_Notes/1.9.0.md@31e52cc10b1f)
  Report interpolation cost as a fraction, not a decimal.
  Rule E forbids a float in a shipped crate; the lint caught the first draft using one.

[d/g31e52cc10b1f-8] decision (cited, source Documentation/CLI.md@31e52cc10b1f)
  Add note that precision is tier rendered to, not accuracy.
  -> causes q/g31e52cc10b1f-8-1

[d/g5880e472260e-1] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Read notes for version being built rather than newest sorted file
  -> causes q/g5880e472260e-1-1

[d/g5880e472260e-2] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Error naming the version when current release notes missing
  The old sort silently read the previous cycle's file and passed when notes were never written. Now a missing notes file for the current version is an explicit error.

[d/g5880e472260e-3] decision (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  Replace old version-sort tests with current-version and missing-notes tests
  -> causes q/g5880e472260e-3-1

[d/g5880e472260e-4] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Make missing-notes test strict about the diagnostic
  Asserting only that some error came back and the message named the version passed with the check disabled because read_to_string also fails and names the path. The test now checks for the specific missing-notes diagnostic.

[d/g5880e472260e-5] decision (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Restore doc comment for check_ci_covers_the_procedure
  -> causes q/g5880e472260e-5-1

[d/g5880e472260e-6] decision (cited, source Documentation/Release_Notes/1.10.0.md@5880e472260e)
  Update release notes with the fix rationale and sweep findings
  Record the change, why it is not a better sort, the missing-notes behavior, and the version-ordering sweep result for 1.10.0.
  -> causes q/g5880e472260e-6-1

[d/g8fdb9b3edb7c-1] decision (cited, source git:8fdb9b3edb7cc175c1f940966840fdc24a6ad03c)
  Replace interpolated event id with literal in event error message.

[d/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2] decision (cited, source git:8fdb9b3edb7cc175c1f940966840fdc24a6ad03c)
  Accept broken pipe as non-fatal when writing test stdin.
  -> causes q/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2-2
  -> causes q/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2-1

[p/g2074788f713e-1-1] constraint (cited, source crates/ucal/src/lib.rs@2074788f713e)
  `now_instant` is the single route shared by `ucal wallclock` and `ucal now`.
  -> conditions d/g2074788f713e-1

[p/g2074788f713e-9-1] constraint (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Session clock with `max` rule exists to document.
  -> conditions d/g2074788f713e-9

[p/g31e52cc10b1f-5-1] constraint (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Granularity is structural and fills T-2.
  -> conditions d/g31e52cc10b1f-5

[p/g31e52cc10b1f-7-1] constraint (cited, source git:31e52cc10b1f6079a130e3bc27479739d7e393eb)
  Rule E forbids a float in a shipped crate.
  -> conditions d/g31e52cc10b1f-7

[p/g5880e472260e-1-2] constraint (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  Release notes are stored as {version}.md files under Documentation/Release_Notes.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-1

[p/g5880e472260e-2-1] constraint (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  check_ci_covers_the_procedure returns Result<usize, Vec<String>>, so an Err is a failed check.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-2

[p/g5880e472260e-2-2] constraint (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  The current version is already derived from [workspace.package] by decision 1.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-2

[p/g5880e472260e-4-1] constraint (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  std::fs::read_to_string on a missing file returns an error message containing the path and version.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-4

[p/g5880e472260e-4-2] constraint (cited, source xtask/src/citations.rs@5880e472260e)
  The missing-notes diagnostic produced by decision 2 contains the phrase a cycle's notes.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-4

[p/g5880e472260e-6-1] constraint (speculative)
  Release notes for the current 1.10.0 cycle are kept in Documentation/Release_Notes/1.10.0.md.
  -> conditions d/g5880e472260e-6

[q/g2074788f713e-1-1] claim (inferred)
  All time readings go through session clock, preventing wallclock face from going back in time.

[q/g2074788f713e-10-2] finding (cited, source git:2074788f713ef4331ede63d3dc963f8e74e7565c)
  Test asserts session reading no finer than raw.

[q/g2074788f713e-11-1] claim (inferred)
  Taking inner value on poisoned mutex is correct because state cannot be torn.

[q/g2074788f713e-2-2] claim (inferred)
  Forward step wins, tracks system corrections arriving.

[q/g2074788f713e-4-1] claim (inferred)
  Pure function lets tests drive wall clock backwards and assert monotonic sequence.

[q/g2074788f713e-5-1] claim (inferred)
  last prevents smaller elapsed inputs from making reading go backwards.

[q/g2074788f713e-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Option avoids .expect, allows anchoring where failure can be returned.

[q/g2074788f713e-7-1] claim (inferred)
  wall_instant exposes raw system clock for doctor --clock and measurements.

[q/g2074788f713e-9-1] claim (inferred)
  Documents one process, one clock and max rule in CLI.md and release notes.

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-1-1] claim (inferred)
  Adding the clock section states what a reading can actually fill, answering the precision field's accuracy …

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-2-1] claim (inferred)
  Doctor --clock must be behind a flag because resolution varies by machine and ordinary output is compared …

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-3-1] claim (inferred)
  Keeping precision unchanged avoids breaking ucal-json/1 paths.

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-5-1] claim (inferred)
  Separation makes clear what each number represents; conflating them is the defect.

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Reporting cancellations helps interpret differences: constant offset cancels, rate error does not.

[q/g31e52cc10b1f-8-1] claim (inferred)
  Note clarifies precision means tier rendered to, not accuracy, preventing conflation with explain's precision.

[q/g5880e472260e-1-1] claim (inferred)
  Check reads current version's notes from [workspace.package], removing ordering guess.

[q/g5880e472260e-3-1] claim (inferred)
  Old version-sort tests replaced with current-version and missing-notes tests.

[q/g5880e472260e-5-1] claim (inferred)
  Doc comment restored for check_ci_covers_the_procedure, leaving function documented.

[q/g5880e472260e-6-1] claim (inferred)
  Release notes updated with fix rationale, missing-notes behavior, and sweep findings.

[q/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2-1] claim (inferred)
  BrokenPipe on stdin write is treated as success, preventing EPIPE race from failing the test.

[q/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2-2] claim (inferred)
  Status and output assertions still execute after an EPIPE, so test validity remains.

[r/g5880e472260e-2-1] claim (cited, source git:5880e472260eb32c58821c7fe4a7497154d590a8)
  Rejected: silently fall back to the previous cycle's notes file
  This fallback could not catch a version bumped without notes and would silently pass on the previous cycle's file.
  -> contrasts d/g5880e472260e-2

[r/g5880e472260e-6-1] claim (cited, source Documentation/Release_Notes/1.10.0.md@5880e472260e)
  Rejected: keep the old release-notes text describing the numeric sort
  That text described the abandoned numeric sort and omitted the adjacent failure and sweep findings.
  -> contrasts d/g5880e472260e-6

[r/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2-1] claim (cited, source git:8fdb9b3edb7cc175c1f940966840fdc24a6ad03c)
  Rejected: Treat any write error to child stdin as fatal using expect("write").
  A broken pipe can occur when the child exits before finishing the write, and that is the program behaving correctly, so the test should not fail.
  -> contrasts d/g8fdb9b3edb7c-2
